TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION_SELECT_SRC
(
                DB_TS
                ,BANK_ID
                ,BRANCH_ID
                ,BAY_USER_ID
                ,CORP_USER
                ,CUST_ID
                ,DEL_FLG
                ,R_MOD_ID
                ,R_MOD_TIME
                ,R_CRE_ID
                ,R_CRE_TIME
                ,CUSTOMER_TYPE
                ,GRP_ID
                ,CUST_BANK_ID
                ,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                DB_TS
                ,BANK_ID
                ,BRANCH_ID
                ,BAY_USER_ID
                ,CORP_USER
                ,CUST_ID
                ,DEL_FLG
                ,R_MOD_ID
                ,R_MOD_TIME
                ,R_CRE_ID
                ,R_CRE_TIME
                ,CUSTOMER_TYPE
                ,GRP_ID
                ,CUST_BANK_ID
                ,FILE_NAME
				,1 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION_SELECT_SRC
(
                DB_TS
                ,BANK_ID
                ,BRANCH_ID
                ,BAY_USER_ID
                ,CORP_USER
                ,CUST_ID
                ,DEL_FLG
                ,R_MOD_ID
                ,R_MOD_TIME
                ,R_CRE_ID
                ,R_CRE_TIME
                ,CUSTOMER_TYPE
                ,GRP_ID
                ,CUST_BANK_ID
                ,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                 CC.DB_TS
                ,CC.BANK_ID
                ,CC.BRANCH_ID
                ,CC.BAY_USER_ID
                ,CC.CORP_USER
                ,CC.CUST_ID
                ,CC.DEL_FLG
                ,CC.R_MOD_ID
                ,CC.R_MOD_TIME
                ,CC.R_CRE_ID
                ,CC.R_CRE_TIME
                ,CC.CUSTOMER_TYPE
                ,CC.GRP_ID
                ,CC.CUST_BANK_ID
                ,CC.FILE_NAME
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION CC
            JOIN d360.STG_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION B
            ON CC.CUST_ID  = B.CUST_ID 
            AND LEFT(CC.FILE_NAME, 5) = LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5)
            AND CC.BRANCH_ID  = B.BRANCH_ID 
            AND CC.CORP_USER  = B.CORP_USER 
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION_GROUP_SRC
(
                DB_TS
                ,BANK_ID
                ,BRANCH_ID
                ,BAY_USER_ID
                ,CORP_USER
                ,CUST_ID
                ,DEL_FLG
                ,R_MOD_ID
                ,R_MOD_TIME
                ,R_CRE_ID
                ,R_CRE_TIME
                ,CUSTOMER_TYPE
                ,GRP_ID
                ,CUST_BANK_ID
                ,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT 
				,FILE_DATE
)

select 
                DB_TS
                ,BANK_ID
                ,BRANCH_ID
                ,BAY_USER_ID
                ,CORP_USER
                ,CUST_ID
                ,DEL_FLG
                ,R_MOD_ID
                ,R_MOD_TIME
                ,R_CRE_ID
                ,R_CRE_TIME
                ,CUSTOMER_TYPE
                ,GRP_ID
                ,CUST_BANK_ID
				,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                DB_TS
                ,BANK_ID
                ,BRANCH_ID
                ,BAY_USER_ID
                ,CORP_USER
                ,CUST_ID
                ,DEL_FLG
                ,R_MOD_ID
                ,R_MOD_TIME
                ,R_CRE_ID
                ,R_CRE_TIME
                ,CUSTOMER_TYPE
                ,GRP_ID
                ,CUST_BANK_ID
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                DB_TS
                ,BANK_ID
                ,BRANCH_ID
                ,BAY_USER_ID
                ,CORP_USER
                ,CUST_ID
                ,DEL_FLG
                ,R_MOD_ID
                ,R_MOD_TIME
                ,R_CRE_ID
                ,R_CRE_TIME
                ,CUSTOMER_TYPE
                ,GRP_ID
                ,CUST_BANK_ID
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = dateadd(dd,-1,@DatetoProcessed)
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.CUST_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CUST_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BRANCH_ID, '-1') = COALESCE(B.BRANCH_ID ,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.CORP_USER, '-1') = COALESCE(B.CORP_USER ,'-1')
AND COALESCE(LEFT(A.FILE_NAME, 5),'-1') = COALESCE(LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5),'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION
(
                DB_TS
                ,BANK_ID
                ,BRANCH_ID
                ,BAY_USER_ID
                ,CORP_USER
                ,CUST_ID
                ,DEL_FLG
                ,R_MOD_ID
                ,R_MOD_TIME
                ,R_CRE_ID
                ,R_CRE_TIME
                ,CUSTOMER_TYPE
                ,GRP_ID
                ,CUST_BANK_ID
				,SCD_START_DATE 
				,SCD_END_DATE 
				,ISACTIVE
				,ISLATEST 
				,BNK_CODE 
				,SOURCE_CODE 
				,FILE_NAME
				,insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                 SRC.DB_TS
                ,SRC.BANK_ID
                ,SRC.BRANCH_ID
                ,SRC.BAY_USER_ID
                ,SRC.CORP_USER
                ,SRC.CUST_ID
                ,SRC.DEL_FLG
                ,SRC.R_MOD_ID
                ,SRC.R_MOD_TIME
                ,SRC.R_CRE_ID
                ,SRC.R_CRE_TIME
                ,SRC.CUSTOMER_TYPE
                ,SRC.GRP_ID
                ,SRC.CUST_BANK_ID
				,SRC.FILE_DATE
				,'9999-12-31'
				,1
				,1
				,LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME, 5)
				,'RIB'
				,SRC.FILE_NAME
				,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
